records.process_description: BA and MA students in Economics (or related departments within the faculty) arrange thesis supervision directly with a professor or contact person; the Department does not allocate topics centrally and has no overview of capacities. Find topics on the faculty list (https://www.oec.uzh.ch/de/studies/general/theses.html) and contact the professor; check the professor’s website for any specific requirements. A BA thesis is 18 ECTS (≈540 h) and an MA thesis 30 ECTS (≈900 h); both have a 6‑month completion period and may start any time by agreement with the supervisor—check graduation/registration deadlines at https://www.oec.uzh.ch/en/studies/general/graduation/degree-deadlines.html. Language, final length (~40 pages), formatting (1.5 spacing, 12pt Times New Roman, 1.5" margins), a ≤150‑word abstract and a signed declaration of authorship are required; these guidelines are recommendations and supervisors may set specific rules.
